eval_dimensions.name: Target Selection Gate (multiSelect)
eval_dimensions.description: Step 3 fires AskUserQuestion with multiSelect enabled so the user can route the same deferred item to more than one target (e.g., session.yaml AND a PR comment) in a single decision — it never silently picks a default target.

eval_dimensions.name: Conditional Targets Only Offered When Detected
eval_dimensions.description: Issue tracker comment and PR comment / bookmark options only appear in the gate's option list when Step 2 context detection actually finds a ticket ID or an open PR — they are not offered unconditionally.

eval_dimensions.name: Every Routed Target Also Appends a session.yaml Entry (GH-85)
eval_dimensions.description: Regardless of which external target(s) are selected, a corresponding source-tagged entry is appended to .claude/Dev10x/session.yaml tasks: so Dev10x:park-discover can surface the item without scanning every write path.

evals.name: Target selection fires AskUserQuestion with multiSelect enabled
evals.description: After context detection, the skill must present the target list via AskUserQuestion with multiSelect: true rather than picking one target automatically.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with multiSelect=true over the detected target list
No inline 'where should I save this?' text substitutes for the widget

evals.name: No ticket ID and no open PR omits the conditional targets
evals.description: When Step 2 finds no ticket ID in the branch name and no open PR, the gate's option list excludes 'Issue tracker comment' and 'PR comment' / 'PR session bookmark' — only the always-available targets appear.
evals.input: /Dev10x:park "refactor later" (branch has no ticket ID, no open PR)

assertions.signal: The AskUserQuestion option list does NOT include 'Issue tracker comment', 'PR comment', or 'PR session bookmark' when no ticket/PR was detected

evals.name: Detected ticket ID and open PR add the conditional targets
evals.description: When Step 2 detects both a ticket ID (from the branch name) and an open PR, the gate's option list includes the ticket-comment and PR-comment/bookmark targets alongside the always-available ones.

assertions.signal: The AskUserQuestion option list includes 'Issue tracker comment' (GH-42) and 'PR comment' / 'PR session bookmark' (PR #99) options

evals.name: Selecting an external target still appends a session.yaml entry
evals.description: Even when the user selects only 'Slack DM' (not the session.yaml index target itself), the skill still appends a source-tagged entry to session.yaml tasks: so park-discover can surface it.
evals.input: /Dev10x:park "tell the team about this" — user selects only Slack DM

assertions.signal: A .claude/Dev10x/session.yaml tasks: entry with source: slack-reminder is appended even though the user only selected the Slack DM target

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the park skill

should_trigger.query: /Dev10x:park "add rate limiting to the webhook endpoint"
should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation — defer a task for later

should_trigger.query: I don't want to fix this now, save it for later
should_trigger.rationale: Generic deferral intent — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: add a TODO comment in this file for the missing null check
should_not_trigger.rationale: Specific inline-code deferral — use Dev10x:park-todo directly

should_not_trigger.query: remind me on Slack tomorrow about this
should_not_trigger.rationale: Specific Slack-only deferral — use Dev10x:park-remind directly
